version.description: The version of this file format

fields.description: One entry per field id: the id is the panel and the label of the field in lower case

additionalProperties.description: One entry, named by its key

purpose.description: What the field is for, shown first in the tooltip
purpose.example: The level this building's door leads into, when its interior is a map; empty follows the kind

range.description: Empty on a number field: made from the field's minimum and maximum

example.description: An example value, shown in the tooltip

suggest.description: How the field offers values: number, none, values:a|b, files:folder/glob, catalog:name

list.description: Comma separated: the suggestion completes the item after the last comma
